findings.evidence: Mathlib `Eigenspace/Basic.lean:497` declares `HasEigenvalue.isNilpotent_of_isNilpotent` with `[IsDomain R] [IsTorsionFree R M]`; lines 72–82 use only that eigenspace API and reducedness of the scalar ring.
findings.fix: State it under `[CommRing K] [IsDomain K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [IsTorsionFree K V]`.
findings.issue: `IsUnipotent.eigenvalue_eq_one` unnecessarily requires `[Field K]`; the proof only needs the domain and torsion-free hypotheses used by Mathlib's nilpotent-eigenvalue lemma.

findings.evidence: Lines 94–96 and 105–107 use only `ρ.map_mul` and `mul_comm`; no group operation occurs.
findings.fix: Replace `[CommGroup G]` with `[CommMonoid G]` for `exists_common_fixedVector_of_isUnipotent` and `exists_fixedLine_of_isUnipotent`.
findings.issue: Both representation specializations require `[CommGroup G]`, although neither uses inverses and `ρ` is only a monoid homomorphism.

summary: Two APIs retain assumptions stronger than their proofs and standard Mathlib generality require.
